responsibility: Defines the full CTFE machine implementation and its persistent interpreter state, including the virtual call stack, evaluation-step accounting, mutable-global access policy, alignment checking mode, recursive-static detection state, and hooks that enforce compile-time memory, pointer, and recursion rules during MIR interpretation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `interpret/machine.rs`, which defines the abstract `Machine` trait, allocation-map abstraction, and the shared compile-time machine macro used by multiple clients, this file is the concrete CTFE machine implementation. It supplies CTFE-specific runtime state and hook behavior—step counting, virtual stack storage, mutable-global and alignment policy, recursive-static detection, and compile-time memory-access enforcement.
